description.value: Hundo-P is a health-focused smoothie and non-dairy ice cream shop that originated in Whistler Village before expanding to Burnaby. Everything is made fresh in front of you using real fruit and whole-food ingredients, with protein-packed 24oz smoothies and a full line of coconut-and-cashew-based ice cream proudly made in Canada. For a touring cyclist, it's a solid stop for a nutritious, on-the-go refuel with options to suit dairy-free and plant-based diets.
